[EN] Can I help you?

I don't know anything about Lok's cultists or some crazy pyramid near Aurum Road, if that's what you've come to ask about.

Not a thing. Seriously. Really. Go away.
[ES] ¿Puedo ayudarte?

No sé nada sobre los sectarios de Lok ni sobre ninguna pirámide loca cerca de Aurum Road, si a eso has venido a preguntar.

Ni una sola cosa. En serio. De verdad. Vete.
